extra.reason: L1.19 static half ported (decision_space.rs); validated equal on all 9 languages.

Built on bvps (Debian 13 x86_64) with a user-local rustup plus musl-tools and mingw-w64. Static-pie Linux x86_64 and Windows x86_64 binaries produced; Linux output is byte-identical to macOS arm64 on the same repos. macOS host still cannot cross-build (Homebrew rustc, no rustup), which the README now records.

Fixed in 02512bc. One boundary walker (_rglob_files) in Python, is_file_entry in Rust; six scan sites in Python and seven walks in Rust now filter to files. The defect was wider than filed: detect_primary_language, bucketed_paths and _repo_has_packages had it too, so a directory named decimal.js counted as a JavaScript file toward language detection. Verified: 357 pytest, 6 cargo tests, parity 16/16 on the repo, on domx and on both C corpus repos.

Fixed in 7f7f1ba. @SuppressWarnings is an annotation node, so the comment arm was dead: zero comments in gson or junit4 begin with it. Counting rule is one annotation, one escape, matching the comment arm's treatment of # type: ignore[a,b]. gson 161 -> 292 escapes, junit4 277 -> 294; both stay Slop. The canon at 03-layer1-indicators.md:228 already listed the marker, so the tool was out of step with the standard and now matches it. Verified: 361 pytest, 10 cargo tests, parity 16/16 on the repo, on domx and on both Java corpus repos.

Fixed in 20d831f. A path component is a test directory when it equals tests/test or ends with .tests/.test, lowercased. Newtonsoft.Json: absolute paths 31 Slop -> 0 Healthy, L1.15 10.61 -> 15.22 (scope shrank 193k -> 69k LOC), L1.17 4.87 -> 7.85, L1.19 11329 -> 10338. RestSharp unchanged (its tests sit under a plain test/ parent). No band moved. Verified: 363 pytest, 11 cargo tests, parity 16/16 across all six corpus repos plus the repo and domx.

Fixed in a6e3df0. Two arms added to _is_test_file in both tools: a path component whose lowercase ends .test/.tests/.spec/.specs, and a file stem ending Test/Tests/Spec/Specs in ORIGINAL casing (the capital keeps Latest.java, manifest.py and Protest.cs on the production side). Newtonsoft.Json 0.0 Slop '0 test / 193720 production' -> 1.8 Healthy '124411 test / 69309 production'. junit4 moves ~200 lines; gson, RestSharp, json-c, libuv unchanged. Production scope deliberately untouched. Verified: 367 pytest, 15 cargo tests, parity 16/16 across all six corpus repos.

Fixed in e29d832. A directory below the root carrying its own .git is skipped by both tools: existence test, so it covers a clone (.git dir), a submodule working copy and a worktree (.git file). Python inside _rglob_files, memoised per call; Rust in a new walk_repo that replaced seven hand-rolled WalkDir loops and prunes the subtree. Verified by recreating the failure: with a worktree of an older commit under .claude/worktrees/, the gate reports 0/0 and both tools agree 16/16. 370 pytest, 16 cargo tests, parity 16/16 across six corpus repos and four local ones.
Fixed in f58f45f: the binary emits one row per canonical indicator, each unmeasured one naming its reason; the parity differ now checks both directions of the key set
Fixed in 61f4090: scope is a named policy resolved through a table that raises on anything undeclared, with a guard test asserting both directions

Fixed: L1.12 and L1.14 went native, _run_external now returns {ran,status,output} so tool-absent and tool-found-something are different facts. Verified end to end on a fixture with a planted GitHub PAT and Slack token.
Fixed: _MEMBERSHIP_TOKENS recognises the 'not in' token, both spellings produce identical verdict and partition, membership marked unordered. Two regression tests, red first.

Fixed in bdc120e: the two enumerators return insertion-ordered dicts, so the serialized row order is source order and stable across processes. Note this was a SERIALIZATION defect, not a determinism one - values were always identical.
L1.12 native on tree-sitter, canon ratio over production LOC with the 1%/5% bands, n/a below an 80% parse rate rather than publishing a ratio over a third of a codebase.
L1.14 native, 16 provider rules plus entropy, gitignored files excluded, distinct secrets counted rather than occurrences.
Open-key selection guard in state_bounds_filters; cross-language conformance suite added; amendment recorded. Python now agrees with the other eight on both open-key shapes.
